## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-06-27: S-1/A first attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.13
- 2013-08-07: Up-C IPO closes; executed TRA dated August 7, 2013
- 2013-11-14: Q3 2013 10-Q files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.7

#### Encana acquisition and TRA preservation

- 2014-09-27: Merger agreement with Encana signed at $58.50/share; Section 8.10 explicitly excludes the TRA from agreements to be terminated; 1,855,563 unexchanged Units outstanding with no recognized TRA liability
- 2014-11-13: Encana acquisition closes
- 2014-12-17: Athlon files Form 15-12B deregistration

## Explanation

Athlon Energy completed its Up-C IPO on August 7, 2013 and executed an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with management-team and employee holders of Athlon Holdings LP Units, covering Section 754 basis step-ups from future Unit exchanges, Section 734(b) Distribution adjustments, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. No payment was ever accrued because no exchanges generated realizable basis step-ups before the Encana acquisition. The September 2014 merger agreement with Encana explicitly preserved the TRA, listing it as the sole exception to the agreements Athlon had to terminate pre-close; Athlon deregistered after the November 13, 2014 close. The contract survives at the deconsolidated entity under Encana ownership, but Athlon's own filings end at deregistration, so the post-merger trajectory is not visible from this CIK. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
